_comment: Controls for shipping the c2507852 engine pin to the JapanFold serving pool (ws:japanfold-opendde-1024-uncap). GWH02 Galaxy Wormhole, out-of-pool cards, prod venv, engine selected by PYTHONPATH with the resolved tt_bio.__file__ asserted per leg. Depth 8192 (--max_msa_seqs 8192), TT_BIO_SIZE_LIMIT=0, engine-default recycles/sampling, which is what the platform sends. Host was contended throughout by three orphaned spawn workers at ~105% CPU each, so wall-clock here is a ceiling, not a best case.

purpose: A/B base: the engine production served before this pin

A/B arm: identical CIF, +1.3% wall inside contention noise. The ending-transpose reserve and the pair-bias row cap are on the shared Pairformer path, and protenix-v2 at 1024 has the least runtime headroom of any model on the pool, so this is the leg that could have blocked the pin

independent reproduction of trace896b off a different worktree on a different card: byte-identical CIF and 1039.6 s against its 1039.5 s. 896 is the largest rung that folds inside the platform's 1500 s predict watchdog, which is why it and not 1024 is what the platform publishes
